claim_text: A detect-only audit should name observable patterns and never infer authorship

notes: Portfolio recommendation inferred from documented source mechanisms

claim_text: Voice calibration and source-bounded personality are a genuine portfolio gap

claim_text: Claim integrity and source-matched precision are a genuine cross-genre portfolio gap

claim_text: Behavioral evaluation should test proposition preservation voice retention and false positives rather than only package structure or marker counts

claim_text: Any optional linter should be context-aware explainable non-authorial and non-mutating by default

claim_text: Kami contributes useful genre overlays for evidence-bearing titles captions precision current facts and cross-surface drift
